title: Deeplus Canonical HIR-H1 R77 integrated-surface atomic cutover
description: Machine-bound canonical HIR payload. Audit baseline, audit status, and product status are deliberately outside the instance semantic projection.

CaptureFieldId.description: Body-local stable identity of one closure-environment field. It is semantic HIR/MIR residue and is never a module API identity.

TraitLanguageRoleId.description: Closed core-owned language responsibility identity. This domain is distinct from TraitId.

UnsignedMagnitude.description: Shortest lowercase hexadecimal unsigned big-endian byte magnitude; 00 is the sole zero.

PositiveMagnitude.description: Shortest lowercase hexadecimal strictly-positive unsigned big-endian byte magnitude.

x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.implicit_exact_root: only an absent non-resource root header may use this mode; declared_envelope is null and computed_envelope exactly becomes effective_envelope
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.resource_root: a sealed resource family root requires EXPLICIT_HEADER
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.explicit_header: a root or child may declare this mode; effective_envelope equals declared_envelope and an explicit child may equal or narrow the family root
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.inherited_sealed_root: a child without an explicit header inherits the sealed family-root effective envelope and has a null declared_envelope
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.declared_envelope_nullability: declared_envelope is null exactly for IMPLICIT_EXACT_ROOT and INHERITED_SEALED_ROOT and non-null exactly for EXPLICIT_HEADER
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.computed_envelope: normalized sorted-unique union of the exact transitive contributions
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.local_compatibility: computed_envelope is a subset of effective_envelope on both axes
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.family_subset: for every child, effective_envelope is a subset of the family-root effective envelope; family_subset_proof_or_null is null exactly for a root
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.contribution_trace_order: BASE_OWNER, then FIELD_OWNER in declaration order, then OWNER_DEF_CLEANUP; this is diagnostic/trace order only
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.runtime_cleanup_order_unchanged: OWNER_DEF_CLEANUP, then own fields in reverse successful acquisition order, then BASE_OWNER

responsibility_evidence_id_or_null.description: Exact ResponsibilityEvidenceId for COPY or CLONE. The referenced module descriptor owns the canonical rule, evidence kind, and any selected Clone witness/error/effect/acquisition/cleanup residue. This value never reuses ResponsibilityProfileId.

responsibility_profile_id.description: Callable responsibility profile identity, disjoint from ResponsibilityEvidenceId.

TraitAssociatedStaticSelection.description: Non-structural, statically closed identity residue for one <T as Trait>::item selection. It adds no HIR node identity and never authorizes runtime reconstruction or search.

ResponsibilityEvidenceDescriptor.description: Non-structural typed-HIR descriptor. It does not add a HIR node identity and is disjoint from callable ResponsibilityProfileId.

x-deeplus-machine-contract.occurrence_profile_rule: The root source_profile is the sole occurrence profile. Nested profile overrides do not exist.
x-deeplus-machine-contract.preview_pattern_rule: A Preview pattern exists only in EXPLICIT_PREVIEW and its containing PATTERN_ATTEMPT reachability is FEATURE_GATED with a nonempty required feature set.
x-deeplus-machine-contract.no_recovery_unknown_rule: Every canonical discriminator is closed. Analysis recovery, unresolved, overload-set, unknown, and the two rejected pre-HIR patterns cannot validate.

integrated_surface_atomic_cutover_r77.structural_unfold_source_surface: *Expr selects POSITIONAL_FINITE and **Expr selects STATIC_NAMED_FINITE under closed owners
integrated_surface_atomic_cutover_r77.structural_unfold_seal: the lexical marker fixes POSITIONAL_FINITE or STATIC_NAMED_FINITE before formal binding and overload selection
integrated_surface_atomic_cutover_r77.named_rest_requirement_owner: source-signature contract only; callable RequiresClause remains distinct
integrated_surface_atomic_cutover_r77.mutable_list_edit_lowering: existing CallExpr and CallPlan(mode_target_pair,call_head_id) with a closed CallableImplementationId
integrated_surface_atomic_cutover_r77.range_step_source_residue: normalized selected Range construction; source punctuation is absent after typed HIR
integrated_surface_atomic_cutover_r77.failable_binding_lowering: one consuming Failable::branch call followed by existing pattern-attempt and control-exit identities

focused_verifier_obligations: Recompute schema_digest and authority_digest from the selected machine contract and authority bundle.
Require every FEATURE_GATED required_feature_ids set to be a subset of the root feature_set.feature_ids and recompute feature_set_digest.
Require feature_ids and required_feature_ids to be deterministically sorted.
Resolve every payload_ref to exactly one GenericPayloadEnvelope in the same body.
Require payload owner_expr_id, owner_expr_kind, payload_contract_id, slot order, slot roles, reference classes, and cardinalities to exactly match the integrated identity catalog payload contract.
Require every structural plan to match exactly one of the thirteen StructuralPlan discriminators and require every optional value to use its required *_or_null field.

Require each ClosurePlan capture_plan_id and CaptureFieldId to be body-local and unique; require CaptureFieldId and source_ordinal projections to be one-to-one, zero-based, contiguous, and in exact source order.

Require every closure capture to match exactly one tagged ReferenceCapture or InitializerCapture; require every capture normalized_type_id to equal its closed result type and every initializer_binding_kind to be exactly LET or VAR; reject DEEP before typed HIR in every source profile.

For COPY and CLONE ReferenceCapture rows require one nonnull responsibility_evidence_id_or_null resolving to exactly one module ResponsibilityEvidenceDescriptor with the same normalized TypeId and the canonical CopyValue or Clone rule respectively; require all other admitted reference modes to carry null, preserve the Clone descriptor's exact TraitWitnessId, ErrorSetId, EffectRowId, ResultAcquisitionPlanId, and CleanupPlanId, and never substitute callable ResponsibilityProfileId for ResponsibilityEvidenceId.

Require closure capture evaluation left-to-right exactly once; MOVE and ONCE prepare only an exact move reservation while any fallible work remains; every precommit failure rolls back the prepared prefix in reverse acquisition order without consuming the source; only after all fallible preparation succeeds may a straight-line nonsuspending interval perform source-ordered PLACE_MOVE and BUILDER_STAGE, BUILDER_COMMIT, and infallible CLOSURE_MAKE with no failure edge or partial environment or closure publication.

Require capture-list state, residence, closed-ancestor-frame assertion, and sorted unique lexical dependencies to satisfy their cross-field constraints; CapturePlanId, CaptureFieldId, eval, place, region, loan, reservation, cleanup, and value identities remain non-API value-level identities.
Require each named plan-reference slot to resolve to exactly one StructuralPlan whose structural_identity_id is the exact plan class required by that slot.

For each CleanupRegistration, require source_registration_ordinal to be contiguous in source order and equal deferred_call_plan.source_registration_ordinal; require cleanup scope identity equality, exact once-only dynamic operand ordinals, zero-evaluation static evidence, body-semantic-digest-bound defaults, and three-phase CLEANUP_REGISTER then CLEANUP_PIN* then CLEANUP_SEAL publication.

Reserve every MOVE_INTO_PLAN owner during preparation and atomically consume it into the plan at CLEANUP_SEAL; on any pre-seal failure, disarm the unpublished registration and release only the prepared prefix in reverse acquisition order without claiming rollback of external effects.

Reject missing or extra plan fields, unresolved or cross-body plan references, noncontiguous ordinals, cardinality mismatches, multiply-owned children, wrong reference domains, and omitted nullable encodings.
Reject missing, duplicate, orphan, cyclic, cross-body, or multiply-owned payload and node references.
Resolve PatternAttempt.lowering_id and pattern_kind_id to the same admitted pattern registry row.
Require each lowering-row hir_identity_ids entry to resolve in the exact 129-row catalog and to equal the identities implied by its dispatch key.

Require every ResponsibilityEvidenceDescriptor to preserve exact ResponsibilityRuleId and ResponsibilityEvidenceId domains, normalized TypeId, evidence kind, registry revision, derivation digest and all nullable behavioral/value-level fields; this non-structural table adds no HIR identity-catalog row.

Require every TraitAssociatedStaticSelection to preserve one SelectionId and exact TraitId, RequirementId, ConformanceId, TraitWitnessId, ImplementationId, SubstitutionId, and ResponsibilityId; require associated types to emit no runtime operation, associated values and bare function references to use DIRECT_DECL plus STATIC_REF, and invoked associated functions to use ORDINARY::TRAIT_WITNESS without runtime reconstruction or search.

Require every structural unfold source to be sealed exactly once as POSITIONAL_FINITE or STATIC_NAMED_FINITE before formal binding and overload selection; an expected formal, expected result, overload winner, or runtime key cannot choose the seal.
Require every trait_language_role_bindings row to use the closed core registry, remain unique by TraitId, and preserve the exact role contract digest into public API and consumer HIR identity.

Require every MutableList structural-edit surface to disappear into an existing CallExpr and closed CallPlan/CallableImplementationId; reject an edit-specific HIR or MIR opcode and require receiver, selector, and payload evaluation exactly once before one mutation commit.
Reject every removed numeric type suffix before canonical CST/AST/HIR; one recovery diagnostic may exist outside this schema but no split numeric prefix or suffix identifier can validate.

Require any repeated TraitAssociatedStaticSelection with the same selection_id in ResolvedRef, CallPlan, or MIR static identity residue to be byte-for-byte equal after canonical serialization; associated-type selections never occur as ResolvedRefExpr or ReferenceCapture values.

Require every ORDINARY or MESSAGE non-reserved CallPlan to carry exactly one OrdinaryCallSelectionV1 whose candidate-domain and argument-descriptor digests bind the consumed analysis-HIR ResolvedOverloadSetRef, whose selected declaration, implementation, substitution, call shape, and specificity proof are closed before operand evaluation, and whose selected_count is one with no runtime or backend relookup.
Reject any reuse of callable ResponsibilityProfileId as ResponsibilityRuleId or ResponsibilityEvidenceId and forbid runtime or backend responsibility-evidence relookup.
Require responsibility_evidence_descriptors to be strictly ordered by responsibility_evidence_id, unique by that ID, and fully reachable from the typed-HIR semantic facts that selected them.

Allow only LOWER or NO_RUNTIME_EMISSION lowering rows. Capability insufficiency is not represented as a lowering row; preserve the verified HIR semantic digest exactly and do not create ExecutableHirH1.

Require each type-header cleanup budget envelope to be sorted and unique, restrict computed contributions to BASE_OWNER, FIELD_OWNER, or OWNER_DEF_CLEANUP, recompute the computed union, prove it is a subset of the effective envelope, and prove every child effective envelope is a subset of the family-root envelope.
Require every construction lifecycle plan's cleanup_budget_id to resolve to exactly one module-level cleanup_budget_envelopes record for its most-derived class.
